'''Docking Bay 24''' was a docking bay in the [[D'larah]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the planet [[Demophon]]. Prior to the [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] that destroyed the [[Demophon system/Legends|Demophon system]], members of the [[G'uotr Network]] led by [[Choaaty Mossk]] attempted to hijack a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and escape the planet. They were stopped by the [[D'larah City Patrol]].<ref name="TC" />
